tools.name: get_service
tools.description: One service at The Wellness by its key from search_services. In London it returns what the service is and what is included, the fee in GBP as the checkout charges it, the duration, the clinic, the named doctors for that service with their published credentials and GMC register links, the Care Qualit

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Times to offer for one service, by its key from search_services. Every service returns times every 15 minutes in opening hours, starting 30 minutes from now. Times are London time and are confirmed by the clinic after booking.

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description: Use this when the person wants to request a London appointment. Returns the URL they open to check their details and pay on Stripe. Nothing is confirmed or charged until they do. Sends The Wellness a request for any service in any city, and the team replies to arrange it; this does not itself book. tools.description: Search the specialist directory at The Wellness, a doctor-led clinic and technology company, by condition, specialty, doctor name, city or country. tools.name: request_specialist_appointment
tools.description: Request an appointment with one specialist, for a person who has agreed to it. Two calls. First without confirmation_code: nothing is sent, and the answer is a summary and a code. Show the summary to the person. If they confirm, call again with the same details, the code and consent true. Free text

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search The Boutique, the online shop of The Wellness (a doctor-led clinic and technology company), with supplements and health technology chosen by its doctors. Returns live prices in GBP and the product page URL to buy. UK delivery only; standard delivery is included.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one Boutique product by its URL slug, id or full product URL. Returns the live price, description, highlights, images, identifiers, delivery options and the page to buy it.

tools.name: create_basket
tools.description: Build a Boutique basket for the person and get the checkout link. Pass the products from search_products (id or slug) with quantities, and subscribe: true for subscribe-and-save where the person wants it. Returns a summary to read back to the person, each line at the price checkout charges, anything

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_service" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_booking_link, request_appointment, search_products, get_product · Private data: search_services, get_service · Public sink: create_booking_link, request_appointment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_booking_link, request_appointment, search_products, get_product · Private data: search_services, get_service · Public sink: create_booking_link, request_appointment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
